answer_2.quote: We computed entire-sequence log probabilities for acceptable and unacceptable sentences in each pair using the minicons library. Accuracy scores reflect the proportion of pairs where the model assigned a higher probability to theacceptable sentence.

answer_4.quote: We collected acceptability judgments from 30 native Turkish speakers using a 7-point Likert scale (1: completely unacceptable, 7: completely acceptable).
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated each sentence on a 7-point Likert scale from 1 (completely unacceptable) to 7 (completely acceptable).
